author: everestmcarthur
install_msg: Welcome to **EveCogs**! Use `[p]cog list` to see available cogs.
name: EveCogs
short: A collection of advanced cogs for Red-DiscordBot.
description: EveCogs is a premium cog repository featuring NexusCore (the ultimate all-in-one server management cog with tickets, applications, suggestions, reaction roles, giveaways, logging, moderation & economy), Wormhole v3.4.0 (cross-server relay with 85+ hybrid commands, context menus, ToS gate, reports, analytics & more), Support (modernized contact/dm system replacing Red's built-in commands with categories, logging, blocking & customization), NewHelpMenu (Components V2 help overhaul), VoiceMeister (ultimate temporary voice channel system with Join-to-Create, persistent control panel, name templates, game detection & logging), SelfbotGuard (advanced selfbot detection), ServerWhitelist (owner-only server join whitelist with blacklist, lock mode, interactive browser, purge & export), UserSlash (user-installable slash-command bridge — every Red command works in servers, DMs & group DMs), GhostWipe (auto-deletes a departing member's messages server-wide on leave/kick/ban, with a full HTML audit-log viewer), ImageVault (auto-deletes posted images, re-hosting them in a private vault channel first so they can be retrieved on request, with spoiler tags preserved), and Affiliates (Ping-on-Join, a persistent modal/select-managed affiliate-server board, and a separate DM-affiliates list sent to new members on join).
